Maya (Support): FYI customer T-ACME-42 reports p99 spikes on /v1/generate since ~13:17 UTC. They see GPU OOMs and auth retry storms, p99 up ~5x. Logs attached.

Maya (Support): ```
[2026-03-16T13:17:03Z] ERROR allocator: slab_eviction_failed tenant=T-ACME-42 kv_total_bytes=24.7GB kv_growth_rate=45MB/min slab_frag=0.73 p99=3560ms
[2026-03-16T13:17:05Z] WARN auth: token_retry tenant=T-ACME-42 502->retry
```

Jordan (Oncall): @Maya can you paste tenant id & route? did fallback routing kick in? Any queued requests?

Maya (Support): Tenant T-ACME-42, route /v1/generate-text-7b, pool s-nyc-gpu-pool-3. Queue depth briefly hit 120, fallback to cpu-small wasn't enabled for this customer.

Sam (eng-runtime): Looks like aggressive KV growth + slab fragmentation. From recently collected heapstats:

Sam (eng-runtime): ```
kv_cache_entries=1.2M
kv_total_bytes=24.7GB
gpu_mem_allocated=47.2GB
gpu_mem_free=0.8GB
slab_free_ratio=0.27
alloc_slab_evictions=3
```

Priya (eng-sre): I think allocator is hitting fragmentation threshold, evictions failing -> retries -> auth/backpressure cascade. Immediate mitigations:
- enable per-tenant aggressive eviction: --kv-retention-steps=8
- reduce max concurrent streams for tenant to 8
- runtime flag: --alloc-slab-evict-threshold=0.65
- enable hot-defrag: --alloc-defrag=1
Also recommend pinning to q4_0 model variant to drop memory ~10GB while we stabilize.

Maya (Support): I'll open rollout ticket and apply canary to s-nyc-gpu-pool-3 now. Command I'm running:

Maya (Support): ```bash
redwoodctl rollout-config set --pool s-nyc-gpu-pool-3 --flag alloc_slab_evict_threshold=0.65 --flag kv_retention_steps=8 --canary 5
```

deploy-bot: Rollout started for s-nyc-gpu-pool-3: canary=5 -> 3 healthy, 2 pending

Sam (eng-runtime): Also please enable active fallback routing for this tenant to cpu-small until KV growth confirmed mitigated:

Sam (eng-runtime): ```
redwoodctl tenant update T-ACME-42 --fallback-candidate cpu-small --fallback-threshold 300ms
```

Maya (Support): Applied patches, canary healthy. Customer reports p99 dropped from ~3500ms -> ~480ms after canary.

Lee (Customer Success): Customer confirms improved responsiveness, will monitor overnight. We'll follow up if it recurs.

Priya (eng-sre): We'll schedule allocator tuning as a cluster-wide rollout if stable, and create alert on kv_total_bytes per-tenant to catch early.

Maya (Support): Closing this support thread for now, will reopen if we see reoccurrence. :white_check_mark:
